_doc: JOINT_TASKS (Phase 047): people acting together. The same tables as the bigville pack, so the shared joint-action code reads one shape. Switch: physical_subsystems.joint_actions (default off). The hamlet has no crewed recipe, so only the tables are here; their numbers and sources are in the bigville pack's _doc (APPROX model choices).

carry.trigger: a physical object on the ground within reach whose load is above one adult's capacity (load_unit)

crew.trigger: a timed recipe whose `crew` field asks for more than one worker, with the worker at the site
